Strelitzia seed from South Africa's Wild Coast.

Request a Quote Our Process

Strelitzia reginae seeds, produced on a commercial scale and hand-picked on our farm near Kei Mouth, are air-freighted to seed distributors and growers worldwide. Also available, to meet specific orders, are Strelitzia nicolai seeds that are bought in from independent seed pickers operating along South Africa's Wild Coast region.

A working Strelitzia farm on the Wild Coast

Wild Coast Seeds (Pty) Ltd, is based on a farm close to the village of Kei Mouth, situated on the coastal region of South Africa known as the 'Wild Coast'. The Strelitzia reginae plants, native to this region, were originally established in the specially selected growing lands, over a period commencing in 1973. When the original owners, due to health and other reasons, were unable to continue with the venture, Etienne Kruger secured a lease over the property in 2015. Etienne's expertise and knowledge regarding the Strelitzia species was initiated in 1959 while a scholar at Selborne College and living in East London. Many years of Strelitzia growing and experimentation, amply qualify him to oversee this magnificent production unit, stretching close to 1.2 kilometers and hand tended from end to end. In June 2023, Wild Coast Seeds (Pty) Ltd, with Etienne Kruger as sole owner and director, acquired full rights and title to the farm.

Our seed is hand-picked, and not only on the farm itself. Over the years, more than 2,000 independent seed pickers along the Wild Coast, from the East London area up toward Port St Johns and at times as far afield as Mozambique, have supplied stock through Wild Coast Seeds. It is a genuine community of growers and pickers behind every shipment we send out.

Life on the farm: sunbirds and the Kei Mouth birding club are regular visitors among the flowers.

Strelitzia reginae: the queen of our fields

The name reginae is Latin for queen, and this is the Strelitzia most people picture: bold orange petals with a deep blue crown, held above paddle-shaped leaves. It is the backbone of what we grow at Kei Mouth and makes up the bulk of the seed volume we ship each season.

  • Orange and blue flower, the classic Bird of Paradise silhouette
  • The variety grown in greatest volume on our farm
  • Seeds are graded after reaping, drying and cleaning. Only A-grade seeds are sold. These are shiny, jet black with orange arils.

S. reginae flowering across our fields at Kei Mouth, ready for the next pick.

View photo

Strelitzia nicolai: the Giant Bird of Paradise

Strelitzia nicolai grows as a tall, tree-like plant with white and blue flowers and the same paddle-shaped leaves as reginae, just much larger. This variety is not cultivated on the farm as it grows prolifically in the natural forest and riverine areas of the Wild Coast. Seed pickers/collectors from many of the local communities living along this stretch of coastline, make their living by harvesting and selling the seeds of this indigenous species. Wild Coast Seeds assists these rural communities with the marketing, sales and distribution of this produce. In so doing we contribute towards the social upliftment that is critical to the survival of many poor rural families.

  • White and blue flowers on a tall tree-form plant, sometimes called the Giant Bird of Paradise.
  • Seeds are handled in the same way as with all Strelitzia varietals – dried, cleaned and packaged, ready for shipping. Only A-grade seeds are sold. As with S. reginae, S. nicolai seeds are shiny, jet-black with orange arils. However, with regard to size, they're slightly larger resulting in fewer seeds per kilogram than their reginae counterparts.

S. nicolai grows wild in the natural forest and riverine areas of the Wild Coast.

From the field to the freight hold

Every batch of seeds passes through the same five stages before it leaves Kei Mouth.

01

Hand-picked

Every seed pod is hand-picked by pickers from the Kei Mouth community, working the fields the same way pickers have for generations.

02

Dried and cleaned

Seed is dried, winnowed and sorted, with damaged and B-grade seed being removed by hand before it goes any further.

03

Viability tested

Seed viability is checked with a Tetrazolium test, which showed that 98% of seeds were viable.

04

Inspected and certified

All seeds are examined by government inspectors before exporting. The Phytosanitary Certificate they issue, attests to a healthy quality product being shipped.

05

Air-freighted

Finished seed is weighed, bagged and boxed, then air-freighted to clients in Europe, the United States and worldwide.

Bulk Strelitzia seed, ready for export

Wild Coast Seeds supplies Strelitzia seeds in bulk to wholesale seed merchants as well as commercial growers and plant nurseries worldwide. Apart from these bulk supplies, smaller retail orders are also catered for.

It is good to note the following:

As time progresses from the date of reaping the ripe pods, Strelitzia seeds slowly lose weight due to the natural drying out process and resultant loss of moisture. At the time of packaging orders, our staff accurately weigh the contents of each container. This means that the sealed containers, although losing weight during shipment, will still contain the original number of seeds comprised in the shipment at packaging date.
